audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Cosmic Binding as the read but has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never states Bard's Q stun cancels Pyke's Bone Skewer channel.
audit.why: Bard's Q (Cosmic Binding) is hard CC and Pyke's Q is an interruptible channel, so a landed Cosmic Binding cancels a Bone Skewer in progress.

edits.before: - Bard Cosmic Binding: matchup-defining — The wall-stun starts every Bard pick — never hug terrain near him. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Ghostwater Dive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Cosmic Binding (Q) is 11/10/9/8/7s and stuns off a wall — it also cancels your Q channel, so commit yours after his is spent. - Keep W Ghostwater Dive banked for his 110-80s Tempered Fate. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
